questions.prompt: Which of these are dwarf planets?
questions.fact: Ceres sits in the asteroid belt and is the only dwarf planet inside Neptune's orbit. The others are moons.

questions.prompt: Which of these are capital cities today?
questions.fact: Canberra was built from scratch as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne. Rio lost the title to Brasilia in 1960, and Istanbul lost it to Ankara in 1923.

questions.prompt: How many bones are in an adult human body?
questions.fact: 206. A baby is born with around 270, and many of them fuse together as the skeleton grows.

questions.prompt: How long is a marathon, in kilometres?
questions.fact: 42.195 km, fixed in 1921 to match the 1908 London course from Windsor Castle to the stadium.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest desert outside the polar regions?
questions.hint: It covers most of North Africa.
questions.fact: Antarctica is the largest desert of all. A desert is defined by how little rain falls, not by sand.

questions.prompt: Which country is the croissant originally from?
questions.fact: The kipferl came from Vienna. Paris bakers turned it into the buttery croissant in the 1830s.
